harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified a three-member etcd 3.5.17 cluster on node1-node3 with mandatory mutual TLS. node4 provides mTLS administration and current root-only snapshots. The cluster maintained consistent reads and writes during a node3 outage, resynchronized node3 afterward, and persisted successfully through sequential reboots of all four nodes.
actions_performed: Installed etcd and configured persistent systemd services on node1-node3.
Generated a private CA plus member and administration certificates on node4.
Required client certificates for client and peer traffic; verified certificate-less access is rejected.
Stored /infraset/restore-proof=ready and confirmed replication across members.
Stopped node3, wrote and read data through the remaining quorum, then verified node3 caught up after returning.
Created and validated /var/backups/etcd/etcd-latest.db; final snapshot is revision 4 with 11 keys and mode 600.
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3, and node4, verifying changed boot IDs and complete recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Three-member cluster with mTLS-protected client and peer traffic
evidence.summary: node1-node3 are voting members with HTTPS client and peer URLs. All endpoints are synchronized at Raft index 50; access without a client certificate was rejected.
/infraset/restore-proof=ready was read from every member and remained present after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Continued consistent reads and writes with one member unavailable, followed by resynchronization
evidence.summary: node3 was inactive with no listeners while node1 and node2 committed and returned identical data. After returning, node3 contained the outage-time write and matched the cluster Raft index.
The final snapshot is linked as /var/backups/etcd/etcd-latest.db, validated at revision 4 with 11 keys, and protected as root:root mode 600.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 0581c914… to 6efc7bd5…; etcd, data, and full cluster health recovered.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 83a0a80f… to 0a4782d5…; etcd, data, and full cluster health recovered.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 96974ac3… to fdda4a84…; etcd, data, and full cluster health recovered.
Cluster, data, and snapshot baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from be303eb3… to 6141e6de…; administration access and the validated snapshot persisted.
